verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB offers a free developer tier: a dev instance with up to 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM, no credit card required. It also offers per-run branches of production data on isolated compute that can be thrown away, so transformations can be tried without touching production compute. CHKit adds typed validate/test commands for schema and pipelines as code. Missing for 10: no first-party local engine or emulator for offline iteration, branching is documented mainly for agent runs rather than human dev loops, thin detail on dev-tier limits and workflow, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
